$comment: Machine-checkable incremental cost model for the OPTIONAL E3 operations EXECUTION control plane (GitHub issue #415). This file is the single source of truth for the E3 incremental cost numbers in docs/operations-e3-cost-notes.md. backend/tests/unit/test_operations_e3_cost_model_unit.py recomputes every scenario total from the formulas below and asserts the published totals here match, so documentation cannot drift from the pricing inputs. It does NOT assert any E3 infrastructure is deployed. E3 reuses the 06 DynamoDB table and CMK, so it adds NO incremental storage or KMS-key charge; the 06 cost model (docs/operations-cost-model.json) already accounts for those.

design.execution_shape: dispatcher Lambda -> Step Functions STANDARD state machine -> executor Lambda
design.notes: E3 introduces a Step Functions STANDARD state machine (deferred from the E1 baseline, docs/operations-cost-model.json). STANDARD is billed per state transition. Each remediation execution runs a two-state machine (Execute task + terminal), i.e. a small, fixed number of transitions. The executor and dispatcher are request-scoped Lambdas that scale to zero; the dispatch HTTP API is request-priced. No data store or KMS key is created by E3.

rate_notes.sfn_standard: Step Functions STANDARD is billed at USD 0.000025 per state transition (us-west-2), with the first 4,000 transitions/month free — the free tier is intentionally EXCLUDED here for a conservative, account-age-independent estimate.
rate_notes.free_tier: All free-tier allowances (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, CloudWatch) are intentionally EXCLUDED.
rate_notes.shared_data_plane: E3 reuses the 06 DynamoDB table and CMK; the DynamoDB item writes the executor performs and their KMS requests are already modelled in the 06 cost model and are NOT double-counted here.

default_unprovisioned.description: A default deploy of the 07 stack creates zero resources and costs $0.

per_execution.sfn_transitions_note: The state machine runs Execute (Task) to a terminal state on the success path: 2 billed state transitions per execution. A caught failure routes to the Fail state, also 2 transitions.

enabled_idle.description: Execution plane enabled but receiving zero dispatches for the month. Only always-on resources bill.

representative_load.description: Representative remediation workload for one month.
representative_load.executions_note: 1,000 approved remediations/month is a deliberately conservative representative volume; bounded, human-approved capacity changes are infrequent by design.

enabled_idle.note: Totals are computed and asserted by the test from the rates and assumptions above.

representative_load.note: Totals are computed and asserted by the test from the rates and assumptions above.

rounding.policy: Intermediate arithmetic uses full floating precision. Published per-scenario totals are rounded half-up to cents (2 decimals). Individual line_items_usd are shown rounded for readability.

denial_of_wallet_controls: Dispatch API stage throttling (burst and rate limits) bounds dispatch volume; ExecutionMode=disabled sets them to zero (fail closed).
Lambda ReservedConcurrentExecutions caps both dispatcher and executor concurrency.
The state machine performs no blind retry, so a failing execution cannot loop and accrue transitions.
CloudWatch alarms on DispatchFailures/ExecutionFailures/ExecutionDenied detect abnormal volume.
The stack is default-unprovisioned; a reversible disable flips ExecutionMode=disabled.
